declared-capture-side: migrated
declared-side-versus-observed-head: consistent: the capture declares the migrated side and HEAD 0e13c8620d is not the base commit

HOW TO USE THE DIGEST.  The comparison this deliverable exists to support
rests on both captures having been written by the same program.  Compare
the producer-sha256 row in the two env/toolchain.txt files: equal digests
mean the same bytes of program wrote both, and unequal digests mean they did
not, whatever either capture says in prose about it.  A previously committed
pair of trees was assembled by three different generations of this script
while both asserted the producer was identical, which is precisely the
failure a digest makes impossible to repeat unnoticed.

A dirty repository-tree-state means this capture cannot be reproduced from
any commit alone: the tree it ran against differed from the head it names.
That is recorded rather than prevented, because capturing from a working
tree is the ordinary case while the change set is being developed.
